invocations.apiAdaptation: Upstream tests parser-level IOException from stream; in kk-studio, InputStream reading and parsing are composed in JdkHttpSseTransport/HttpSseStreamExecution, where body read failure transitions to onFailure(TransportErrorKind.IO) exactly once without onComplete.

Upstream parser provides a ParsingHandle to cancel parsing; in kk-studio transport, cancellation is controlled via ProviderStream.cancel(), verified by reentrant cancellation on the first event callback.

invocations.capabilityMismatch: kk-studio transport uses IncrementalSseParser exclusively and does not implement or expose a blocking-only ServerSentEventParser abstraction or fallback. Testing that an incremental parser fails to support async is inapplicable.
